authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now

proposals.evidence: Turner9758 explicitly distinguishes the l-extension, with Marathi/Konkani māsḷī fish and Prakrit maścalī, from the bare matsya and matsiya branches. Davar masle retains that l-extension; the source final e and nonretroflex l are preserved. The existing promoted extension node is9758-3. No immediate recent donor is established; existing source lect mapping and readings are retained.
